To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of a high-level language allows programmers to specify spatial and temporal coherence requirements with a small set of simple constructs, 2) a distributed shared state system that exploits high-level coherence information can reduce communication traffic by an order of magnitude, 3) the performance of the system is robust to changes in the coherence specification.
InterWeave reduces communication traffic by up-to one order of magnitude for a variety of applications, and that this is achieved with minimum effort on behalf of the application programmer.

(1) the performance of distributed shared state can be greatly improved by using high-level coherence information, (2) this can be done with little programmer effort and (3) this is especially important for pointer-rich, strongly-typed data structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a distributed shared state system that can provide high performance with a low programming burden, and with the development of application-specific optimizations that take advantage of high-level knowledge of the application's spatial and temporal data access patterns and coherence requirements.
the design of an application-specific distributed data sharing system that is easy to program and easy to optimize for a wide range of applications.

the development of an efficient and flexible mechanism for supporting distributed shared state, and with the development of techniques to exploit high-level information about applications' data access patterns to improve the performance of distributed shared state systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
InterWeave is an effective distributed shared memory system that can significantly reduce the cost of communication between cooperating processes.
InterWeave is an effective and efficient distributed shared state middleware that can be easily used by application programmers to develop distributed shared data applications with minimum effort.

InterWeave provides a simple, efficient, and scalable mechanism for sharing pointer-rich data structures, and that the application of the techniques described here to other applications is likely to be fruitful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have designed and implemented a distributed shared-memory system that provides a high-level interface that is simple to program with and yet is capable of achieving high performance on a wide range of applications.
InterWeave is an object-oriented middleware system that supports sharing of strongly-typed data structures across a variety of hardware architectures and operating systems.
InterWeave is the first distributed shared state system to exploit high-level application information to improve performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the programmer can be given the ability to specify the desired degree of coherence and the system can automatically provide it.
, by exploiting high-level coherence information, it is possible to achieve significant performance improvements in a variety of applications with minimal programmer effort.
, by leveraging high-level information about data structures and applications, it is possible to obtain significant improvements in performance with minimal programmer intervention.
